guidance: Every installation step has finished. Setup is waiting at its final check for this: The public resolver 1.1.1.1 reports host-192-0-2-10.provider.set18.test as the reverse DNS (PTR) name of this server’s address 192.0.2.10; mail servers expect mail.set18.test. You set this at your server provider, not in CelikPanel: in the provider’s control panel, or by asking its support to set the reverse DNS of 192.0.2.10 to mail.set18.test. A change made at your server provider can take from a few minutes to several hours to reach public DNS, because DNS resolvers keep the old name until their saved copy expires. Once you have made the change, you do not need to do anything more in CelikPanel. Setup checks again by itself and finishes when every check passes. To check now, use Check requirements again.
